title: Let customers change the quantity of a pending order
description: Adds PATCH /api/orders/:id with a new `quantity` for one of the customer's pending orders. The order keeps the unit price it was placed at, even if the product's price has changed since. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The new total multiplies the old total, not the unit price, by the new quantity, so any order whose quantity was more than 1 is overcharged (2 at 1200 changed to 3 becomes 7200, not 3600).
